name: Harper
description_en:
Harper now describes a unified application/data runtime and a managed cloud service called Fabric. The legacy harperdb.io homepage redirects to harper.fast. The vendor separates the single-node core, source-available Pro distribution and hosted Fabric; they should not be treated as one uniform license or free cloud entitlement.

The official REST tutorial shows a local application, schema-generated endpoints and explicit CRUD payloads. Use that as a development example, then verify authorization and failure handling separately. No continuity of an old HarperDB Cloud account, data, subscription or deployment is inferred from the website redirect.
description_zh:
Harper 当前描述统一应用／数据运行时及托管云服务 Fabric，旧 harperdb.io 首页跳到 harper.fast。厂商区分单节点 core、源码可见 Pro 和托管 Fabric，不能视为同一许可或统一免费云权益。

官方 REST 教程展示本地应用、按 schema 生成端点和明确 CRUD 载荷，可作开发示例，但授权和失败处理需另测。官网跳转不证明旧 HarperDB Cloud 账户、数据、订阅或部署自动连续。

core_features.name_zh: 按 schema 生成 REST 端点
core_features.explanation_en: The tutorial derives table endpoints and connects them to a small todo application.
core_features.explanation_zh: 教程派生表端点并接入小型待办应用。

core_features.explanation_en: The 5.0 announcement distinguishes core runtime, distributed Pro capabilities and managed Fabric.
core_features.explanation_zh: 5.0 公告区分 core 运行时、Pro 分布能力及托管 Fabric。

core_features.explanation_en: Fabric pricing combines data, compute and messaging with total and rate allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: Fabric 价格结合数据、计算、消息的总量及速率额度。

en: Connect a disposable todo app to schema-generated endpoints and verify failed-write handling.
Compare single-node components with Fabric region/block allowances before deployment.
zh: 将可丢弃待办应用接到生成端点，并验证写入失败处理。
部署前比较单节点组件与 Fabric 区域／block 额度。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose core/Pro/Fabric explicitly, and prepare a disposable schema plus test credentials.
steps.zh: 明确选择 core／Pro／Fabric，准备可丢弃 schema 及测试凭据。

steps.en: Verify actual request authorization, update payloads and selected cloud blocks before moving real data.
steps.zh: 迁移真实数据前验证请求授权、更新载荷及所选云 block。

items.en: The REST tutorial is a development example, not production authorization acceptance.
items.zh: REST 教程是开发示例，并非生产授权验收。

items.en: Cloud block totals, per-minute limits, region counts and expiry all affect usable capacity.
items.zh: 云 block 总量、分钟限制、区域数及到期都会影响可用容量。

pricing.summary_en: Fabric publishes limited Start from $0/month, Scale from $84/month and custom Enterprise. Start blocks renew after six months; Scale blocks expire after three. Cloud pricing is separate from core/Pro software licensing. Actual block quantities, taxes, contract, full license and workload bill remain unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: Fabric 列受限 Start 每月 $0 起、Scale $84 起及定制 Enterprise；Start block 六个月更新，Scale block 三个月到期。云价与 core／Pro 软件许可分开，真实 block 数、税费、合同、完整许可及工作负载账单待核。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.title_en: Do not transfer entitlements across the product family
sections.title_zh: 不要在产品家族间转移权益
sections.en: The 5.0 announcement separates Apache-licensed core, Elastic License2.0 Pro and hosted Fabric. Pro adds replication and clustering. That distinction does not grant every Fabric feature for redistribution or prove legacy contract migration. Confirm the required component and deployment.
sections.zh: 5.0 公告区分 Apache 许可 core、Elastic License 2.0 Pro 与托管 Fabric，Pro 增加复制和集群。这不授予全部 Fabric 功能再分发权益，也不证明旧合同迁移。应确认所需组件及部署。

sections.title_en: Generated endpoints still need application-level checks
sections.title_zh: 生成端点仍需应用级检查
sections.en: The 2026 tutorial installs a local instance, uses Studio and derives REST endpoints from a schema. Its todo update example explicitly sends both the changed value and another existing field. Inspect the actual payload and response handling when adapting that example. A working local development sample does not establish anonymous-production access, correct authorization or successful behavior on failed writes.
sections.zh: 2026 教程安装本地实例、使用 Studio，并从 schema 派生 REST 端点；待办更新示例明确同时提交变更值及另一已有字段。适配时应检查真实载荷和响应处理。本地示例可运行不证明生产可匿名访问、授权正确或写入失败时仍成功。

sections.title_en: A major-version announcement is not a migration rehearsal
sections.title_zh: 大版本公告不是迁移演练
sections.en: The 5.0 announcement introduces RocksDB alongside LMDB, offers migration tooling and acknowledges some breaking changes. Before upgrading an existing database, rehearse application behavior and a restorable backup using disposable data. Vendor compatibility and performance claims were not measured.
sections.zh: 5.0 公告在 LMDB 外增加 RocksDB，提供迁移工具并承认部分破坏性变化。升级既有库前应以可丢弃数据演练应用行为及可恢复备份，厂商兼容与性能主张未实测。

sections.title_en: A core license summary does not cover every component
sections.title_zh: Core 许可摘要不覆盖全部组件
sections.en: The licensing FAQ permits commercial use, modification and redistribution of the identified open-source projects without royalties, subject to attribution/license text. It separately describes source-available components with different terms. The full repository/distribution license text was not reviewed here, so the record does not assert one open-source classification for the whole platform.
sections.zh: 许可 FAQ 允许所列开源项目在署名及保留许可文字条件下免版税商业使用、修改及再分发，同时说明源码可见组件有不同条款。本次未审完整仓库／发行版许可，因此不对整个平台作统一开源分类。

sections.title_en: Read total blocks and per-minute rates together
sections.title_zh: 同时读取 block 总量与每分钟速率
sections.en: Fabric Start is listed from $0/month with limited totals, rates, compute and a six-month block renewal; Scale starts at $84/month and its blocks expire after three months. A block is associated with one region. Displayed maximum capacities are not necessarily the capacity bought by the starting payment. Select region, infrastructure and actual block quantities before estimating workload cost.
sections.zh: Fabric Start 列每月 $0 起，附总量、速率、计算限制及六个月 block 更新；Scale 每月 $84 起，block 三个月到期，一个 block 对应一个区域。展示最大容量未必是起价购买的容量，应先选择区域、基础设施及真实 block 数量再估成本。
